title: eludite/project/setLaunchProfile
description: Create, edit, rename or delete a launch profile in `Properties/launchSettings.json` (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"), writing the file with System.Text.Json's nodes: the profiles' order, every other member (unknown ones too) and the file's indentation, line endings and byte order mark are kept; members are written as Visual Studio writes them. `create` makes the file (and `Properties/`) when missing. The project is not reloaded (the file is not part of the evaluation): the generation does not move.

project.description: Absolute path of a project file of the open solution (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`), or the project file that is open as the solution.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the values under. A value that is not the current generation fails with -32801 (ContentModified) and writes nothing: the file may have changed since (another edit, a reload).

action.description: set: change `values` of an existing profile; create: add a profile named `profile` at the end, a Project profile with the project's defaults (`commandName` Project; a web project also gets `launchBrowser` true and `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` Development) and then `values`; rename: to `newName`, in place; delete.

newName.description: rename: the new name (not one the file has).

generation.description: The generation the profiles were read under.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

file.description: Absolute path of `Properties/launchSettings.json` (it may not exist).

profiles.description: The profiles, in the file's order.

values.description: The members to set; null removes one. Members not named are kept, and so are members Eludite does not know.

commandName.description: Project, Executable (IIS Express is read-only off Windows).

environmentVariables.description: The whole table, in order: variables already in the file keep their place, new ones are appended, missing ones are removed. Empty or null removes the member.

profile.description: One launch profile of `Properties/launchSettings.json`, in the file's order.

name.description: The profile's name (its member name under `profiles`).

commandName.description: Project (run the project), Executable (run `executablePath`), IISExpress, IIS, Docker, or another tool's kind, as written.

environmentVariables.description: The environment variables table, in the file's order.

launchBrowser.description: Open a browser on the site when the project starts.

launchUrl.description: The page to open, relative to the application URL, or absolute.

applicationUrl.description: The URLs the app listens on, `;`-separated.

executablePath.description: Executable profiles: the program to run.

readOnly.description: IIS Express (and IIS) profiles off Windows: listed read-only.

unknown.description: The names of members Eludite does not edit; they are kept as they are on every write.

environmentVariable.description: One environment variable, in the file's order.
